title: Crane Field Golf Course
specs: 18-hole course with detailed hole strategy guide
Driving range with regular and large buckets of balls
Weekly association leagues with competitive events and handicaps
Golf cart drivers must be at least 16 years old with a valid state issued driver’s license
Minors under age 12 must be supervised at all times
Infants and children under age 6 are not permitted on the course grounds or golf carts
Guests must create an online profile and provide a valid credit card to book tee times
Maximum 4 players per tee time and 2 carts per foursome
